posts.text: We had the second stupidest idea in all of Toronto… This past Saturday, Ethan Yang, Jeremy Liu, and I won second place at Toronto’s Stupid Ideas Hackathon! Does this mean we are smart or stupid? I don’t know, but what I do know is that I loved attending — huge thank you to Smit P. and Kallie Zhang for organizing! We won a hackathon in 30 minutes...? This past Wednesday, I had the opportunity to attend the Cursor community event in Toronto! The event kicked off with some incredibly inspiring speeches given by Chris Yip (shoutout UofT Engineering!), Jeremy Liu and Ethan Yang (shoutout Sinatra!), and Caden Chau (shoutout Shad!).
